doubts: prince-paul-of-yugoslavia: note only says he served; his WWI service (Serbian side) is thin in sources, entente assumed
konstantin-fedin: Russian civilian interned in Germany, not a member of any camp -> null
vernon-kellogg: neutral American relief (CRB, 1915-16, before US entry) -> null
eduard-bernstein: side taken from the relation (voted war credits Aug 1914); he turned anti-war in 1915 and co-founded USPD, so antiwar-socialists is defensible
karl-kautsky: centrist; the relation stresses his 1917 anti-war break, so antiwar-socialists; he did not oppose war credits in 1914
max-von-baden: POW/Red Cross relief work, but as a German prince and later chancellor (Oct 1918) he belonged to the Central Powers; null also defensible
karl-korsch: served in the German army while refusing to bear arms; kept on central-powers as serving soldier
bukharin: relation is about Brest (revolutionary war), marginal to WWI; placed with anti-war socialists

anti-war leadership: robert-grimm set as leader (Zimmerwald organizer, ISC chair); balabanova and zetkin executor (ISC secretary / organizer of 1915 women's conference); other former opponents participant
voldemar-ulmer: army not stated in note; assumed Russian imperial army
wilhelm-groener: linked after the initial read (61st row); central-powers executor
bukharin: changed participant -> leader, as head of the Left Communist revolutionary-war camp
trotsky: kept in soviet-government (delegation head, abstained to let Lenin win) although his 'neither war nor peace' line was a third position
carl-gustaf-emil-mannerheim: Finnish White commander who opposed the German intervention; placed with germany-and-allies because the White government allied with Germany

volodymyr-vynnychenko / mykhailo-hrushevsky: Central Rada made a separate peace with the Central Powers and invited German troops, hence germany-and-allies; the Rada was an independent actor, and Vynnychenko resigned before the treaty
yakov-blumkin: Left SR assassination of Mirbach carried out a party decision; kept participant, executor also defensible
boris-kamkov: Left SR co-leader with Spiridonova; set participant, leader defensible
nikolai-glebov-avilov: scuttled the Black Sea Fleet on government orders to keep it from Germany -> soviet-government executor

pavlo-skoropadskyi / anton-denikin: German-backed Hetmanate and Denikin's Whites were distinct camps, grouped because both were anti-UNR and anti-Bolshevik and Skoropadskyi ended with a federation-with-Russia line; a separate 'Hetmanate' side is an alternative
jozef-pilsudski: Polish ally of the UNR only in 1920; placed with ukrainian-peoples-republic (label does not name Poland)
nykyfor-hryhoriv: fought for the Soviets until May 1919, then revolted; placed with peasant-insurgents
grigory-grinko: Borotbists were a Ukrainian left SR party allied with and then merged into the Bolsheviks; placed with soviet-forces
vladimir-vernadsky: witness (academy founder under the Hetmanate) -> null
pyotr-wrangel: fought the Soviets at the same time but Poland refused cooperation with the Whites, so given his own side
maxime-weygand: French adviser on the Allied mission, actively advising the Polish staff -> poland-and-unr participant
stanislaw-bulak-balachowicz: fought under Polish command; his later independent Belarusian campaign still anti-Soviet -> poland-and-unr
julian-marchlewski: head of Polrevkom, a Soviet-sponsored provisional government; kept leader on the Soviet side, executor also defensible

zhang-zuolin: opponent -> leader of the Beiyang warlords (Beijing government head, target of the Northern Expedition); executor defensible since the relation is about the embassy raid and Li Dazhao's execution
wang-jingwei / song-qingling: Wuhan KMT left; Song sided against Chiang and later with the CCP. A separate 'Wuhan KMT left' side is an alternative to lumping them into kuomintang
chiang-kai-shek: kept executor (Northern Expedition commander under Sun); by 1927 he led the KMT right, so leader is arguable
label ko '공산당과 소련·코민테른' is 12 chars; Soviet advisers (borodin, blyukher, bubnov, joffe) and Stalin/Trotsky/Roy placed here although advisers formally served the KMT
trotsky: critic of the united-front line inside the Soviet party; still in the CCP/Comintern camp
yeo-un-hyeong: joined the KMT at Sun's urging -> kuomintang
he-long: KMT army commander who led the Nanchang uprising and joined the CCP right after -> ccp-and-comintern
zinoviev / kamenev: in the triumvirate with Stalin 1923-25, New Opposition 1925, United Opposition with Trotsky 1926-27; given their own side because their camp changed
lenin: leader kept, side null; he stood above the camps (his testament was the struggle's central text, not a faction's program)
august-thalheimer: KPD leader blamed for the 1923 German October; not part of any Soviet camp -> null
arkadi-maslow / ruth-fischer: KPD ultra-left who backed the United Opposition (and were close to Zinoviev); placed with left-opposition
alfred-rosmer / boris-souvarine: expelled for defending Trotsky -> left-opposition (rosmer stays target)
alexander-voronsky: signing the 46 is doubtful in the literature (he was more a sympathizer); kept left-opposition per the relation
no opponents in this event, so no re-kinding needed
lyushkov: NKVD Far East chief who defected to Japan in June 1938 and gave it intelligence; placed with japan-manchukuo (his act served Japan), soviet-mongolia arguable by origin
hotsumi-ozaki: Japanese member of Sorge's Soviet spy ring -> soviet-mongolia participant
chiang-kai-shek: outside recipient of Soviet aid, not in either camp -> null
zhang-zuolin: killed by the Kwantung Army in 1928, a precursor rather than part of the camps -> null (target kept)
vasily-blyukher: kept leader of the Soviet side although he was later purged; not re-kinded to target since the relation is about command at Khasan
no opponents in this event
william-seeds: British ambassador in the talks, but kind witness -> side null per rule; could be britain-france if re-kinded participant
willi-muenzenberg: German communist exile who only criticised the pact; belongs to no negotiating camp -> null
molotov: kept participant, though as signatory and chief negotiator executor may fit better
neville-chamberlain: British PM kept participant; leader of britain-france side would also be defensible

kind corrections (not opponents): boris-shaposhnikov, dmitry-lelyushenko, kuzma-galitsky, mikhail-shumilov, nikolai-voronov, pavel-batov, pavel-kurochkin, vladimir-kryukov were 'leader' but are chief of staff / branch / corps / division / brigade commanders -> executor; revert if kind changes are out of scope
jukka-rangell: relation is about declaring war in June 1941 (Continuation War), not the Winter War; kept finland/leader but the link itself may be misplaced
paavo-talvela, erik-heinrichs: notes describe 1940-41 German-Finnish coordination (Continuation War prep); side finland but link relevance doubtful
edouard-daladier: French PM who only pushed aid to Finland -> outside government reacting, side null
alexei-vinogradov: executed by his own side after defeat; kept participant on soviet side (could be target of Mekhlis's reprisal, but not of the war's action)
kuusinen: puppet 'Finnish Democratic Republic' head placed on soviet side, not finland
aleksandr-tvardovsky: Soviet war correspondent but witness -> null per rule

kind corrections (not opponents): maurice-gamelin leader->executor (army commander-in-chief, not the government); henri-rol-tanguy leader->executor (commanded the Paris FFI rising under de Gaulle's side). Revert if out of scope
charles-huntziger: signed the armistice as delegate of Petain's government (later Vichy war minister) -> vichy rather than french-republic
heinz-guderian: kept participant; a panzer corps commander could be executor
pierre-laval: kept participant; as Vichy head of government from 1942 executor/leader is arguable
aime-cesaire: subjected to Vichy censorship in Martinique; not in any camp -> null (target arguable)
raoul-van-overstraeten: Belgian adviser, witness -> null
Germany has no leader (Hitler not linked)

kind corrections (not opponents): isoroku-yamamoto, chester-w-nimitz, frank-jack-fletcher, raymond-a-spruance, alexander-vandegrift leader->executor (fleet/theater/task-force/division commanders, not heads of a side). Revert if out of scope
mao-zedong: CCP fought Japan within the united front but was not a formal Allied government -> allies, arguable
ho-chi-minh: Viet Minh resisted Japan and worked with OSS; placed in allies, but could be null
kanji-ishiwara, seishiro-itagaki: roles are the 1931 Manchurian Incident (pre-1941 background); side japan
sides here are conference delegations of allied powers, not warring camps; if the editor prefers treating the conferences as one camp, return null instead
herbert-vere-evatt: Australian, acted at San Francisco against great-power veto, not a Yalta/Potsdam delegation -> null
togo-shigenori, naotake-sato: Japan was outside the conferences (target of the Soviet entry pledge) -> null
anthony-eden: note describes San Francisco co-chairing, but he was British foreign secretary at Yalta/Potsdam -> britain
maurice-thorez: opponent -> participant (PCF leader opposing the plan inside the communist camp; mirrors togliatti)
josip-broz-tito: relation is the 1948 break with Stalin; in 1947 Yugoslavia was in the Cominform, but his linked role is the rupture -> null
ludvik-svoboda: non-party defence minister who let the 1948 coup pass; leaned communist but not formally in the camp -> null
edvard-benes, jan-masaryk: non-communist Czechoslovak leaders pressured by Moscow; belonged to neither bloc -> null, kind target kept
evgeny-varga: Soviet economist sanctioned for deviating from the two-camps line; still inside the soviet bloc
Czechoslovak coup (1948) people are mixed into this event; the camps fit it only loosely

doubts: kind correction (not opponent): vasily-sokolovsky participant->executor (Soviet military governor who walked out of the ACC and ran the zone during the blockade). Revert if out of scope
robert-murphy: Clay's political adviser, clearly western camp, but kind witness -> null per rule; could be western-allies/participant
wilhelm-pieck: kept leader, but Stalin (the actual top of the Soviet side) is not linked; executor/participant arguable
james-f-byrnes: role is 1945-46 background (Potsdam, Stuttgart speech); side western-allies
josip-broz-tito: target -> leader of the yugoslavia side (the expulsion was aimed at the whole party he led; with sides he heads his camp). Keep target if the editor prefers
dimitrov: Bulgarian leader rebuked over the Balkan federation; Bulgaria joined the Cominform condemnation -> soviet-cominform, but his own role is ambiguous

arso-jovanovic, sreten-zujovic, andrija-hebrang: Yugoslav Cominformists/pro-Soviet dissidents -> soviet-cominform camp; arso-jovanovic 'executor' of a coup is doubtful (participant may fit; he was shot fleeing)
khrushchev, bulganin: 1955 reconciliation, Soviet side
jawaharlal-nehru: non-aligned partner, no camp -> null
bela-kiraly: Hungarian officer-witness -> null
raya-dunayevskaya: US Trotskyist who opposed the war from outside both camps; re-kinded opponent -> witness, side null (could alternatively be dropped from the event)
tsiang-tingfu: ROC delegate chairing the UNSC; placed on south (ROC backed the UN resolutions) though ROC did not fight
klement-gottwald: Czechoslovak leader in the Soviet bloc but only asked Stalin about the boycott; kept witness, side null
kind fixes (not opponents): georgy-lobov, oliver-p-smith, deng-hua, chae-byeong-deok leader->executor (commanded one part, not the top of a side); nam-il leader->executor (chief armistice delegate)
lin-biao: declined command; kept participant on north
wang-ming: Chinese communist in Soviet exile who wrote Soviet-side propaganda against Mao; placed on soviet
Cuba kept as its own side because Castro and Moscow split over the withdrawal (Mikoyan mission); merge into soviet if two sides preferred
oleg-penkovsky: Soviet GRU colonel spying for US/UK; placed on usa as the camp he acted for
fulgencio-batista: ousted in 1959, background only; kept target, side null
richard-heyser: US U-2 pilot kept witness/null; arguably usa participant
u-thant: UN mediator, side null
kind fixes: issa-pliyev leader->executor (commander of Soviet forces in Cuba); robert-mcnamara leader->executor (defense secretary under Kennedy)
yuri-orlov: Soviet dissident arrested by his own government, not part of either negotiating camp; target, side null
thomas-brimelow: British diplomat who drafted the counterproposal for Kissinger; placed on usa (Western camp)
henry-m-jackson / charles-vanik: Congress opponents of Kissinger's detente, still on usa side
urho-kekkonen: neutral host, side null; leader->participant since he led no camp
dissidents side: they acted after signature (Moscow Helsinki Group, Charter 77) against their own governments; merge or drop if the page should show only the negotiating camps
nuon-chea: current kind target reflects the 2018 tribunal, outside the event; as KR 'Brother Number Two' re-kinded leader of khmer-rouge (keep target if the trial is meant)
norodom-sihanouk: nominal DK head of state 1975-76 then under house arrest; placed on noncommunist resistance per his relation (FUNCINPEC/CGDK)
event summary only covers 1975 DK rule; sides reflect the 1979 regime change and the resistance period in the title
stefan-wyszynski: Primate mediating between church, state and Solidarity; side null
john-paul-ii: spiritual patron of Solidarity; placed on solidarity
konstantin-rusakov: only Soviet person; own side 'soviet' (could merge into government side, or null)
stanislaw-kania: PZPR first secretary until Oct 1981, participant->leader of government side
piotr-jaroszewicz: 1976 price-rise premier, background to the event; government executor
oleg-gordievsky: KGB officer working for British intelligence; witness, side null
markus-wolf: East German spy chief but here a retrospective witness; side null
erich-mielke: Stasi chief supplying KGB; soviet participant
deng-xiaoping: 종류를 executor에서 leader로 바꿈. 계엄과 소개를 최종 결정한 최고 지도자다.
hu-yaobang: 진영을 null로 둠. 그의 죽음이 시위의 계기가 되었을 뿐 사건 기간에 어느 쪽에서도 활동하지 않았다. target 종류도 잘 맞지 않지만 그대로 두었다.
zhao-ziyang: 진영을 movement로 둠. 계엄에 반대하고 광장의 학생들을 찾아갔다가 실각했다. 다만 운동의 일원이 아니라 당 지도부 안의 반대자였다.
wei-jingsheng: 진영을 movement로 둠. 1989년 운동 기간에는 수감 중이었고, 석방 청원의 대상이었다.
li-xiannian, bo-yibo: 종류를 executor 그대로 둠. 두 원로는 계엄 결정을 지지했을 뿐이어서 participant가 더 맞을 수도 있다.
george-h-w-bush: 외부 정부로서 반응만 했으므로 진영을 null로 둠.
구성상 문제: 한 나라 안의 정책 논쟁이다. 500일 계획을 두고 두 안이 실제로 맞섰으므로 진영을 두었지만, 협동조합과 광부 파업처럼 이 구도 밖의 사안도 함께 다룬다. 이 사건을 진영 없는 사건(null)으로 보는 것도 가능하다.
gorbachev: 진영을 union-gov로 둠. 두 안 사이에서 절충했지만, 결국 연방 정부안 쪽으로 기울었다.
abel-aganbegyan: 진영을 union-gov로 둠. 고르바초프의 지시로 절충안을 썼다.
gaidar-yegor: 진영을 radical로 둠. 1991~1992년 러시아 정부에서 활동했으며, 1990년 논쟁의 직접 당사자는 아니었다.
mikhail-shchadov: 진영을 union-gov로 둠. 연방 석탄공업장관으로 파업 광부들의 상대였고, target은 그대로 둠.
artyom-tarasov: 협동조합 스캔들의 당사자로, 두 개혁안 진영 밖에 있으므로 null로 둠.

label.en: Yeltsin and the resistance to the coup
Gorbachev and the Union and party centre
Republic leaders who dissolved the Union

doubts: kryuchkov: 종류를 executor에서 leader로 바꿈. 쿠데타를 설계하고 주도한 사람이어서, 진영을 두면 쿠데타 세력의 정점에 선다.
gennady-yanayev: 종류를 executor에서 leader로 바꿈. 대통령 권한대행으로서 비상위원회의 공식 수반이었다.
gennady-burbulis: 종류를 leader에서 executor로 바꿈. 옐친 밑의 국가서기로서 벨로베자 합의문을 설계했을 뿐, 진영의 최고 결정권자는 아니었다.
yevgeny-primakov, vadim-bakatin: 진영을 resistance로 둠. 두 사람은 고르바초프 쪽 연방 관료였지만, 쿠데타 기간에 루츠코이와 함께 저항 편에서 움직였다.
shevardnadze, yakovlev: 진영을 resistance로 둠. 쿠데타를 경고했고, 쿠데타 때 백악관 쪽에 섰다.
yevgeny-shaposhnikov: 진영을 resistance로 둠. 소련 공군 총사령관이었지만 쿠데타 중단을 관철했다.
anatoly-lukyanov: 진영을 gkchp로 둠. 비상위원회에 가입하지는 않았으나 동조 혐의로 체포되었다. union으로 둘 수도 있다.
pavel-grachev: 진영을 null로 둠. 비상위원회에 협력하면서 백악관에 공격 계획을 몰래 알려 양쪽에 걸쳤다.
galina-semyonova, bessmertnykh: 진영을 union으로 둠. 당·정부 지도부 안에서 비상위원회를 거부했거나 가입을 거절했을 뿐, 저항 세력에 합류하지는 않았다.
dzhumgalbek-amanbayev, lembit-annus: 쿠데타 지지 입장을 밝힌 정치국원이어서 진영을 gkchp로 둠. alfreds-rubiks(target)도 gkchp로 둠. 나머지 정치국원은 union으로 둠. yuri-prokofyev는 실제로 쿠데타를 지지했다는 설이 있지만, 연결된 note 문구를 따라 union으로 두었다.
leonid-shebarshin: 쿠데타 뒤 고르바초프가 임명한 대행이어서 진영을 union으로 둠.
marju-lauristin: 에스토니아 독립을 확인한 의원이어서 진영을 republics로 둠.
vladimir-usov, ilya-krichevsky, dmitry-komar: 백악관 방어에 나섰다가 숨진 희생자여서 진영을 resistance로 둠.
george-h-w-bush, jack-matlock, vladimir-putin, pyotr-luchinsky(witness): 진영을 null로 둠.
paul-von-hindenburg: 종류를 participant에서 leader로 바꿈. 참모총장으로서 구체제와 군 진영의 정점이었다. 실권은 그뢰너에게 있었으므로 participant로 남겨 둘 수도 있다.
hugo-haase: 진영을 spd-government로 둠. USPD 소속이지만 1918년 12월까지 인민대표평의회 공동의장이었다.
kurt-eisner: 진영을 councils-left로 둠. USPD 소속 바이에른 총리로 평의회에 기반했지만 공산주의자는 아니었다.
karl-kautsky: 진영을 spd-government로 둠. USPD 이론가로서 정부가 만든 사회화위원회에 참여했다. null로 둘 수도 있다.
radek: 볼셰비키 사절이었으므로 진영을 councils-left로 둠.
friedrich-ebert: 종류를 participant에서 leader로 바꿈. SPD 공동의장으로서 전쟁을 지지한 다수파를 이끌었다.
camille-huysmans: 진영을 null로 둠. 국제사회주의사무국 서기로서 중립국에서 양쪽을 다시 잇는 일을 시도했다.
jean-jaures: 진영을 antiwar로 둠. 전쟁공채 표결과 치머발트 이전에 암살되었지만 끝까지 평화를 주장했다. 진영 분열 이전의 인물이므로 null로 둘 수도 있다.
hugo-haase: 진영을 antiwar로 둠. 8월 4일에는 당 규율에 따라 찬성 성명을 읽었지만, 그 뒤 반전파를 이끌었다.
karl-kautsky, eduard-bernstein: 진영을 antiwar로 둠. 1915년부터 반대로 돌아선 중앙파였다. 레닌의 기준에서는 국제주의자가 아니다.
benito-mussolini: 진영을 social-patriots로 둠. 당 다수파가 아니라 참전을 주장하다 제명된 인물이다.
ramsay-macdonald: 진영을 antiwar로 둠. 평화주의적 반대였다.
pol-pot, norodom-sihanouk: 진영을 china로 둠. 두 사람은 중국의 동맹과 반베트남 연합에 속했다. 라벨을 '중국과 캄보디아 동맹'처럼 넓히는 것도 고려할 만하다.
heng-samrin: 진영을 vietnam-ussr로 둠. 베트남이 세운 정권의 수반이었다.
hoang-van-hoan: 진영을 china로 둠. 베트남 정치국원 출신 친중파로, 전쟁 뒤 중국으로 망명했다.
jimmy-carter, zbigniew-brzezinski: 외부 정부로서 판단을 유보했을 뿐이어서 진영을 null로 둠.

no_sides.reason: A famine/relief episode, not a conflict between camps; Soviet authorities, ARA and the church acted around one disaster.
원전 사고와 국가 수습 작업으로, 서로 맞선 진영이 없는 재난이다.
Armenian and Azerbaijani movements fought each other; centre vs republics would merge them into one side
볼셰비키 주도의 조직 창설이라는 단일 초점 사건이며, 연결된 인물은 거의 모두 가입·창설 쪽이고 반대 진영 인물(가입 반대파)은 연결돼 있지 않다.
